article_dating_expressions.summary: Dating has a vocabulary of its own: a crush, a date, a situationship, ghosting, breadcrumbing. After reading this you know what each label means in practice, how to read a profile and a first message, what to say on a first date, how to ask about mixed signals, and how to end something without hurting anyone.
article_dating_expressions.title: Understanding Modern Dating Expressions

article_psychological_manipulation.summary: Manipulation is not an argument you can win. It is pressure, ambiguity or emotion arranged so that a decision looks like it was yours. After reading this you can name the common patterns, tell persuasion apart from pressure and coercion, recognise the signs in yourself, and use six steps and a set of ready sentences to slow the moment down and keep a real choice.
article_psychological_manipulation.title: Psychological Manipulation: How to Recognise It and Step Out
